reserves.name: Japanese yen deposits and Japanese government bonds

sources.label: JPYC EX launch and reserve disclosure

reserveReview.rationale: JPYC Inc. states that at least 100% of issued JPYC is backed by Japanese yen deposits and Japanese government bonds. It does not disclose current category weights, so the full reserve is represented as one aggregate basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current JPYC issuer reserve disclosure; deposit/bond weights undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer identifies the complete deposit and Japanese-government-bond reserve basket but does not publish its current allocation.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Japanese yen deposits and Japanese government bonds
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The current deposit/JGB allocation is not publicly disclosed.

providers.name: JPYC Inc. statutory funds-transfer safeguarding arrangement

sources.label: JPYC EX launch and funds-transfer registration
Japan Payment Service Association performance-guarantee guidance

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Japanese funds-transfer rules require protection of customer liabilities through a statutory performance-guarantee deposit, eligible guarantee contract, or trust. JPYC does not disclose which method or providers it currently uses, provider shares, segregation mechanics, or rehypothecation terms.
